# Portfolio and P&L tracking

**Know what an agent wallet holds and whether it is up or down, across SOL and ETH, with every fee and gas cost in one ledger.**

Tracks an agent wallet's holdings and profit and loss across Solana (SOL) and Robinhood Chain (ETH, beta) with Claudia's tools — get_my_portfolio and claudia://me/portfolio, claudia status, claudia wallet and wallet evm, the SDK's tokenBalance, getSolBalance and evm.balance, and get_wallet's 7-day view as a cross-check — then keeps a trade ledger with cost basis, network fees, gas, launch costs and creator-fee income, and computes average-cost P&L with an offline script. Use when someone asks "what is my agent holding", "am I up or down", "what did fees and gas cost me", wants a monthly statement, or needs clean records for an accountant. Includes a ledger template and a tax-record caution. Bookkeeping aid only, never tax or financial advice.

## How it works

1. List the wallets and today's spend
2. Snapshot the holdings
3. Build the ledger
4. Put fees in the right place
5. Run the P&L
6. Reconcile
7. Write the statement
8. Keep records, give the tax caution

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/portfolio-and-pnl-tracking.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/portfolio-and-pnl-tracking.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/portfolio-and-pnl-tracking.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/portfolio-and-pnl-tracking.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill portfolio-and-pnl-tracking`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `portfolio-and-pnl-tracking.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/portfolio-and-pnl-tracking`.
